name: paper-figure-tools
description: Reproducible AI/systems paper figures with project-local plots and selected native diagram ownership.

interface.shortDescription: Editable research diagrams and publication plots.
interface.longDescription: Paper Figure Tools sets up reproducible AI/systems paper figure workflows with project-local plot templates, selected native diagram sources, fixed-size vector exports, and regeneration commands. It retains existing formats, project owners and explicit application choices. New unowned research diagrams prefer the accepted OmniGraffle workflow after fresh drawing readiness checks; unavailable native access permits a disclosed Draw.io fallback before dispatch.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-figure-workflow to set up editable diagrams and publication plots with the research figure style.
Review this research repo's figure pipeline and make it reproducible.
